name: audit-a-mitochondrial-gene-split-in-two-models
turns: In the P. falciparum NF54 mitochondrial genome, cytochrome b is served as PfNF54_000013000 (261 aa) and PfNF54_000012600 (130 aa, cytochrome b N-terminal), and the 3D7 protein is 376 aa. Are these gene models right?
rationale: A positive of the answer key: one mitochondrial gene is served as two models. The audit keeps the error on both genes and names the split as its cause.
